title: emergency.py: Falsy timestamp=0 silently uses fallback field
description: Lines 124-125: Uses `body.get("t") or body.get("ts")` pattern. If t=0 (valid per line 141 which only rejects <0), Python evaluates `0 or ts_value` as ts_value. Payload {"from": "...", "t": 0, "ts": 100} silently uses timestamp=100 instead of the explicitly provided 0.
close_reason: Duplicate of vtw7. Bug already fixed - uses 'body["t"] if "t" in body' pattern.
